7.4V Lithium Battery Charger with XH2.54 Connector (1 PCS) - XB003

description_blocks.text: Overview

Meet the All-in-One Fast Charging Kit – the definitive power solution designed to supercharge your CyberBrick experience. We've bundled all you need for continuous, uninterrupted play into one simple kit. Say goodbye to your battery anxiety.
Recommended For:
CyberBrick owners who want to eliminate playtime limits.
Families and friends who enjoy multi-player RC battles.
Hobbyists seeking a professional, efficient charging setup.
Product Features

The Ultimate All-In-One Kit: This complete bundle has it all: 14500 7.4V 800mAh Li-ion Battery*6, 7.4V Lithium Battery Charger*2, and 20W Dual-Port Fast Charger*2. No need to buy anything else – you get a full charging station in one box.

Extend your CyberBrick Playtime: Play longer by changing between multiple batteries, Easily power CyberBrick Ultimate Hardware Kit (2 cars, 2 remotes) simultaneously for epic head-to-head races. One battery drains, and another is ready to go, guaranteeing your fun never pauses.

Simultaneous Charging: Each charging hub is equipped with one USB-A port and one USB-C port, and includes two interchangeable adapters compatible with EU (European standard), UK (British standard), and US (American standard) power outlets. The battery charger included in the set utilizes the USB-A port, while the spare USB-C port serves as an excellent option for powering your other devices.
Warning of Lithium Battery
This product utilizes a replaceable rechargeable lithium battery.
Adult supervision is required when children are handling batteries or the charger. DO NOT operate the product while it is charging.
Ensure the battery is installed correctly. Improper installation may result in short circuits, overheating, or potential explosion.
Regularly inspect the charger's cord, plug, housing, and other components for damage. If any damage is found, discontinue use immediately until the device is fully repaired.
Choking Hazard: Contains small parts; not suitable for children under 3 years of age.
Improper disposal of this product may harm the environment - please recycle responsibly.
Charging Precautions
Official adapter: Fully compatible and 100% safe to use.
Third-Party adapters: Output must not exceed 5V 2A. You can also safely charge via a computer USB port.
DO NOT use fast chargers, 9V/12V adapters, or any power supply exceeding 5V 2A. Doing so may result in device damage, overheating, or fire hazards.
DO NOT cover the device. Keep away from heat, moisture, and flammable materials. Never charge unattended.
DO NOT charge the battery pack if it is overheating. If the charger or battery overheats abnormally, stop charging immediately and contact official support.
Ensure the battery and charger are completely cool and dry before charging.
Lithium Battery Safety Precautions
DO NOT attempt to use or charge the battery pack if it shows any signs of leakage or corrosion.
DO NOT disassemble, crush, or mechanically abuse the battery pack.
DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
Exercise extreme caution when handling an overheated battery pack.

  • DO NOT dispose of the battery pack in fire.
